metadata.title: ADIVASI DAILY | TRIBAL BULLETIN | आदिवासी डेली बुलेटिन
metadata.description: Adivasi daily is a new beginning in the journey of Main Bhi Bharat. It's a bulletin of Tribal India. In this bulletin we will show the top news of the Tribal India. This bulletin will also include your views on the major issues related to the tribal rights and identity.
